toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. TECHNICAL MASK CONVERSION ONLY, exact 1536x1024 source coordinates. The ONLY input is the personally inspected full-color Umiri source with FOUR deliberate FEATURELESS PURE-WHITE paint marks at actual contact receivers. Keep every white-painted pixel and shape in precisely the input position. Do NOT re-detect, redraw, rescale, re-center, move up or re-imagine boots/shadows/anatomy. Output the exact same full canvas.
Keep ONLY the FOUR deliberately painted flat PURE-WHITE areas as WHITE: the little original skirt-underlinen mark, side-palm-underlinen mark, and the two original floor marks hugging the real boot BOTTOMS. Keep the full sole-adjacent footprint beneath the boot, not a mark on its upper or shin; preserve the exact visible white source edge under toe and heel. Keep its narrow soft gray outer antialias/receiver fade at source position, do not shrink the mark to a thin line.
Turn EVERYTHING ELSE solid PURE BLACK: all original colored girl/book/whole boots, black or metallic original highlights, ALL natural cream/white textured cushion/curtains/lamp/knit/flowers/pages, all furniture/wood/reflections/rug/shadows. Natural pale textured cloth is NOT deliberate featureless white pigment. Do not trace ANY person/shoe outline; the black girl vanishes entirely except where a deliberately painted receiver boundary overlaps a tiny source edge. All pixels above y540 black. All FAR RIGHT KNIT/cloth beyond the actual palm white-painted mark BLACK, no long white seat slab or texture pattern.
This is a conversion of the FOUR ALREADY PAINTED receiver shapes, NOT a new receiver-selection or light/shadow design. Preserve their source locations exactly, including the lower front-boot ground patch. Do not infer different contact coordinates. One opaque pure BLACK/WHITE/edgeGRAY mask, no colors, checkerboard, labels, UI, crop or resize. Raw luminance will select original mother RGB once through MAX(F,S) at fixed position, travel/slope/perspective0.
